messages:
ana: Quick sync. Profiler and recent real-traffic traces show a p95 slow_path regression and a KV-cache miss burst for long-prefix flows after the kernel-selector rollout. We need a compact observability board + paging rules to catch future regressions quickly.

sam: OK. What panels/queries should I wire first? I can prototype a Grafana JSON and some recording rules.

ana: (typo, meant ana) Starter metrics I think are essential: avg batch formation count, avg wait time in queue, batch token utilization, cluster tokens/sec, token_budget consumption, kv cache hit+latency by prefix bucket, kernel selection outcomes. Example PromQL starters (adapt as needed):
```
# avg number of requests per formed batch (30s window)
sum(rate(batcher_formed_batch_requests_sum[30s])) / sum(rate(batcher_formed_batch_requests_count[30s]))

# avg queue wait time (ms) - 1m window
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batcher_queue_wait_ms_bucket[1m])) by (le))

# batch token utilization: emitted / reserved (30s)
sum(rate(batcher_tokens_emitted_total[30s])) / sum(rate(batcher_tokens_reserved_total[30s]))

# cluster-wide tokens/sec (30s)
sum(rate(batcher_tokens_emitted_total[30s]))

# token budget usage pct (per-tenant)
sum(rate(token_budget_consumed[1m])) by (tenant) / max(token_budget_target) by (tenant)

# kv cache median latency by prefix bucket
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(kv_cache_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, prefix_bucket))

# kernel selection breakdown (preferred/selected/fallback)
sum(rate(kernel_selection_choice_total[5m])) by (choice, model_variant)
```

sam: Nice. I like the prefix-bucket idea.

yusuf: For alerting I propose these pages:
- cluster_tokens/sec drops below 60% of the 7d same-hour median for >5m -> page
- queue wait p95 > configured_target for >3m -> page
- slow_path p95 increase >30% vs 7d median (time-of-day matched) for >10m -> page
- token_budget_consumption > 90% sustained for >6m -> page
- kv_cache_miss rate for prefix_bucket=\"256+\" > 4% and rising for >5m -> notify
Keep paging thresholds conservative to avoid noise.

maria: Also add a small panel correlating kernel_selection_choice with slow_path_rate and per-variant latency. We need to see if selector is picking fallback kernels frequently for particular model+seq_len ranges.

kevin: FYI the selector rollout that likely correlates is commit 0d9e8f7 (promoted earlier today). Annotate the dashboard with deploy events and link to the PR/commit.

deploy-bot: deploy: batcher-kernel-selector v2.4.0 promoted to prod by @kevin 00 1777801000

ana: Two instrumentation gaps to fix before this is fully useful: 1) add prefix_bucket label on kv_cache_requests/hits/latency (buckets: 0,1-64,65-256,256+), 2) emit kernel_selector_mismatch_total when selected_kernel != compiled_optimal, with low-cardinality sample tags (model_family, seq_bucket).

sam: Recording rules I plan to add: effective_throughput (tokens/sec * utilization) and a 7d_hour_of_day_median baseline for p95 metrics to speed alert comparisons. Will keep high-resolution (30s) recording for 14d and downsample to 5m for 90d.

maria: Also please include a tiny \"recent profiler captures\" list panel (latest 12) that links to flamegraphs/trace IDs. Nightly profiler runs and post-rollout captures should populate it.

yusuf: For the slow_path alert logic, use time-of-day matched median: compare the last 20m p95 to the 7d median for the same hourly bucket. That reduces false positives from diurnal traffic.

kevin: I'll add rollback playbook steps to the runbook and include a short diagnostic query set to run during an incident. Also tag the rollout PR with the dashboard link so on-call can find it immediately.

ops-bot: pinned message: \"continuous-batcher observability checklist\" by @ana

sam: Implementation plan from my side: create Grafana dashboard JSON with panels: formed_batch_count, avg_queue_wait_ms, batch_utilization, tokens_per_sec, token_budget_pct, kv_hit_and_latency_by_prefix, kernel_selection_ratio, slow_path_p95, effective_throughput, recent_profiler_captures. Add deploy annotation stream, recording rules for effective_throughput and 7d_hourly_median baseline, and alert rules with paging mapping. Target: PR today, review tomorrow EOD.

ana: Thanks. After we merge, let's run a 48h observability validation and correlate with profiler flamegraphs. If alerts hit and point to selector causality, rollback and open an RCA ticket. Ping me for flamegraphs or sample traces. :thumbsup:
